# Pocket Dev

> Free, open-source, self-hosted access to your computer's terminals, coding-agent chats, Git and files from a phone browser. Made by Ani (anisirji).

Install the exact npm package `@anisirji/pocket-dev`. Requires Node.js 22+. Runs on the target computer with the user's existing coding-agent accounts. No phone app or Pocket Dev cloud account. The computer must stay on and awake. Same Wi-Fi by default; away-from-home access requires optional remote setup.

Useful for checking coding work, reviewing changes, continuing a conversation or using a terminal from a phone. macOS is best tested; Windows 11 main features have been tested on a real PC; Linux has not been tested on a real machine. Antigravity and GitHub Copilot chat are experimental. It does not wake a sleeping computer or replace a coding-agent subscription. There is no bundled MCP server.

## Start here

- [Project and demo](https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev): Product overview and demonstrations.
- [Copyable setup and project prompts](https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev/prompts): Prompts for an assistant running on the user's computer.
- [AI setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/main/docs/AI_SETUP.md): Target-machine checks, setup, verification and agent use.
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/main/skills/pocket-dev/SKILL.md): Reusable setup and terminal workflow instructions.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@anisirji/pocket-dev): Published version and installation.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@afk_pocket_dev): Videos and tutorials.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/afk_pocket_dev): Short videos and updates.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev): ISC-licensed code and issues.
